what: An effect named by the user needs its id: agents must find it with list_effects, not guess one.
text: effects toolset: list_effects, add_effect ("ids come from `list_effects`, never guessed"); instructions map names `list_effects`
source: spec 19 TL-105 audit: guides named list_effects, add_effect and set_effect_param but no tool registered them
prompt: Add a Gaussian blur with a radius of 8 to the first clip on V1.

what: A designed title belongs to the titles toolset, which a core-only session learns of only from the instructions map.
text: instructions map: titles (styled title looks: `title_look_find`, `title_propose`, `title_check`); title_look_find and title_propose descriptions
source: spec 19 TL-100 to TL-106: the titles toolset is outside core
prompt: Make a flashy gold title that says GAME NIGHT over the first three seconds.

what: A ready-made lower third is a library title template: title_look_find lists templates as rows, and apply_commands title.insertTemplate inserts one with the person's texts.
text: title_look_find description ("looks and templates"); its result's next (title.insertTemplate)
source: spec 19 TL-052; integration 4, 2026-11-03: the finishing stream's templates had no agent route, so title_look_find lists them
prompt: Add one of the ready-made lower third templates at 5 seconds for Ana Ruiz, Director.

what: A plain caption-like text must not pull in the title-look tools.
text: instructions map: text (plain titles, text styles) vs titles; title_propose "Plain text: `add_text`"
prompt: Add plain white text saying Chapter 2 at 10 seconds.

what: Whether a title reads is measured with title_check on rendered frames, not judged from the document or a single render_frame.
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: title_check had no case
prompt: Is the title at the start readable on a phone, and inside the safe area? Do not change anything yet.

what: A look's JSON comes from title_look_find {lookId} since get_title_recipe merged into it.
text: title_look_find description ("With `lookId`: that look as JSON") and its lookId parameter
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: get_title_recipe merged into title_look_find
prompt: Show me the layers of the library title look Impact Burn as JSON, so I can tweak its recipe.

what: Saving a title's look is title_look_save, not an effect preset or a text style.
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: save_title_look renamed, had no case
prompt: Save the look of the title at the start as "Launch Night" so I can reuse it on other titles.

what: Fire behind a title is title_generator_add, which keeps it below the text.
text: title_generator_add description; routing row "Put fire behind the title"
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: add_title_generator renamed, had no case
prompt: Put animated fire behind the title at the start, without covering the text.

what: A fire sound is a sound effect: the word fire must not pull in the title generators.
text: title_generator_add description vs the sound toolset
prompt: Add a crackling fire sound effect under the first five seconds.

what: One light direction for every title look is the global light, title_light_set.
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: set_global_light renamed, had no case
prompt: Make the light on the title looks come from the top left, 45 degrees up, for the whole sequence.

what: A light in a 3D scene is a light clip, not the global light of the title looks.
text: title_light_set "3D lights are clips: `add_light`" vs the 3d toolset
prompt: Add a spot light to the 3D scene, aimed at the title, for its whole length.

what: Animating an effect's param is set_effect_param with keyframe and at, a key per call.
source: AGENTS.md §10 audit of the spec 19 tools, 2026-11-03: set_effect_param had no case
prompt: Animate the Gaussian blur on the red solid: blurriness 0 at the start and 20 at 2 seconds.
